name: Adcorp Holdings Limited
source: CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | Consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 28 February 2026, audited by KPMG Inc. with an unmodified opinion dated 28 May 2026, statement of profit or loss, values in ZAR thousands scaled to units. FY2026 and FY2025 rebuilt from the filing: Revenue 12,458,013 less Cost of sales 11,222,944 equals Gross profit 1,235,069; operating profit before finance income and costs 177,298; finance income 16,427 less finance costs 41,962 gives Net Finance Costs 25,535 and Profit before taxation 151,763; taxation 5,769 gives profit for the year 145,994, of which 146,107 attributable to owners of the parent and -113 to non-controlling interest. Basic earnings per share 141.9 cents. FY2024 and older retained from Yahoo Finance: no filing read for those years. | 20261112_2135: filled 1 null cells from Stock Analysis annual income statement, each row accepted only where it reproduced 29 values already in this file with no contradiction | INTERIM H1 2026: Adcorp Holdings unaudited interim results for the six months ended 31 August 2025 (H1 FY2026), consolidated statement of profit and loss, R thousands: revenue 6394176, cost of sales (5770202), gross profit 623974, other income 6145, loss allowance for expected credit losses on trade receivables (1151), operating expenses (556736), operating profit before finance income and finance costs 72232, finance income 9994, finance costs (21424), profit before taxation 60802, taxation (6323), profit for the period 54479, basic earnings per share 53.0 cents. Operating expenses here are the printed 556736 less other income 6145 plus the 1151 loss allowance, so that gross profit less operating expenses equals operating profit. Statement of financial position at 31 August 2025, R thousands: total assets 3173425, total equity 1486873, non-current liabilities 388341, current liabilities 1298211, cash and cash equivalents and restricted cash 253052, non-current assets 1124201, current assets 2049224. Ties checked: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, profit before taxation less taxation equals profit for the period, total assets equal total equity plus total liabilities, non-current plus current assets equal total assets. | CRON 20261124: FY2022 rows from Adcorp Holdings audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 28 February 2022, consolidated statement of profit or loss at https://www.adcorpgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/FY2022-Adcorp-Group-Consolidation-Annual-Financial-Statement.pdf page 15: profit for the year attributable to owners of the parent R99,037 thousand from continuing operations plus R17,366 thousand from discontinued operations equals R116,403 thousand, non-controlling interest R2,554 thousand, profit for the year R118,957 thousand; total basic earnings per share 109.1 cents (diluted 103.2 cents), computed on 106,692,859 weighted average ordinary shares. The EPS cell was corrected to 1.091 rand from the 1.032 a secondary feed had written, which is the printed DILUTED figure, so the row now shows the basic earnings per share the other rows use. Unit R thousand stored as absolute rand.
